title: Parser document fragment
description: Document-schema fragment contributed by @jxsuite/parser: the content-type `$paths` source shape unioned into the document paths resource.

ContentPathsSource.description: Content-type $paths source: expands a dynamic route from the entries of a loaded content type.

contentType.description: Name of the content type (a key of the project.json `content` section).

param.description: Route parameter to fill from each entry (default "slug").

field.description: Entry field providing the parameter value; "id" (the default) uses the entry id.
